items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: He sounded exactly like Ainto who was a Brazilian percussionist... Ainto is from Brazil and he has a certain accent when he speaks English.

ctx.x: Yes, yes, they're out there passing, right? Yes, and especially on the Coast where you did have all of these people of varying colors, they could get by with it. Yes. Because I'm sure you saw Filipinos darker than some of the people who had that African blood.

I had a Filipino taxi driver on the Islands when we were on a sightseeing tour and he was talking in the front seat, I was in the back seat. He sounded exactly like Ainto who was a Brazilian percussionist. He's down at the concert that day. He was one of the percussionists, and Ainto is from Brazil and he has a certain accent when he speaks English. This man had the identical accent.
